title: iPRA with inferred witnesses
meaning_of_iPRA: Full intuitionistic first-order primitive recursive arithmetic with a symbol for each fixed finite primitive-recursive description and quantifier-free induction with parameters.

new_mathematical_claims.claim: The fixed zero/unit naming probe gives a sound opening rule with only a major-proof and branch-proof premise.
The new calculus is closed under capture-avoiding simultaneous substitution followed by full normalization, including substitutions which create the naming guard.
Ordinary paired-binder elimination and full equality transport are admissible.
For every canonical clause context and canonical conclusion, derivability is equivalent to derivability in the inherited normalized clause calculus.
Composition with the inherited arithmetic bridge gives equiconsistency and bi-interpretability with iPRA, on the whole numerical domain with actual equality and identity numerical composites.
new_mathematical_claims.status: new consequence of written equivalence and inherited bridge
